**Battle of Stalingrad** | Aspect | Details | |--------|---------| | **Main Participants** | • **German side:** Wehrmacht’s Army Group Don led by Field Marshal *Friedrich Paulus*.
• **Soviet side:** Red Army forces commanded from Moscow’s Stavka headquarters, with key commanders such as Lieutenant‑General *Georgy Konev*, Major‑General *Vasily Zhukovsky*, and later Colonel‑General *Andrei Antonov*. | | **Location** | City of **Stalingrad** (today Volgograd), situated on the eastern bank of the **Volga River**, in southwestern Russia. | The battle took place between August 1942 and February 1943, becoming one of WWII’s most decisive engagements.
